Precision weights from estimated diversity

Source: R/tidymodels.R
model_case_weights.Rd

Asymptotic diversity estimates differ in precision between sites: a poorly sampled site has a large standard error. model_case_weights() turns standard errors from div_estimate() or div_boot() into inverse-variance weights, normalised to mean 1, as hardhat::importance_weights() for use with workflows::add_case_weights().

Usage

model_case_weights(se, cap = 100)

Arguments

se

Numeric vector of standard errors.

cap

Largest allowed ratio between weights, to stop sites with an SE near zero from dominating. Inf for no cap.

Value

A hardhat_importance_weights vector.

Examples

est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 1, .by = season)
est$w <- model_case_weights(est$se)
est
